text: A student reads a newspaper article about natural disasters.
the climate crisis is getting worse
In 2019, there were many natural disasters around the world.
According to the United Nations, there was a climate crisis disaster reported
each week in the month of July.
In the first six months of 2019, 7 million people lost their homes.
The World Bank estimated that three regions, South America, sub‑Saharan
Africa and southeast Asia, will have 143 million climate migrants by 2050.
